**Finding: deviation (high severity) — § 12.4 (paragraph p0046)**

The duplicate § 12.4 imposes on us a non-compete for the term plus 24 months, covering development, marketing, sale, or acquisition of "any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory." This breaches the playbook on three counts: it binds the Customer, its scope is undefined, and the post-term tail is double the 12-month walk-away limit. It is also internally inconsistent with § 12.3, where Vendor expressly acknowledges we have made no non-compete or exclusivity commitment.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** delete p0046 in full. No substitute language is needed because § 12.3 already preserves our freedom to operate; the narrowed fallback (single named product, term only, 12-month cap, carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions) is offered in the comment as a negotiating concession.

Note: the preceding § 12.4 (p0045) contains a separate 24-month no-hire restriction on us — outside this rule's scope but likely a hit for the no-hire/non-solicit rule.
